## Reflections on possitioning in the interview setting

I am a physiotherapist by training and lead countless anamneses with patients. In that setting I usually aim at coaching the patient to find insight about his or her level of physical activity and come up with strategies that may increase it. This is very different from interviewing a participants with the aim of getting information from the person without affecting their relationship to physical activity. 

Usually a do not inform the participant about my bagground, to avoid them formulating an ansvwer that may please a person like me. But if they ask I have obliged to answer truthfully. Further, I can not run from the fact that I am fairly well trained, which states my personal relationship with exercise.
